grid=[list(map(int,x.split())) for x in inp.splitlines()]
def transform(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); fg=max(set(sum(grid,[]))- {min(set(sum(grid,[])))})
 # identify foreground as non-background most? use largest color (> background)

 seen=set(); out=[r[:] for r in grid]

  for c in range(w):
   if grid[r][c]!=bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
   q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]; border=False
   while q:
    a,b=q.pop(); comp.append((a,b)); border |= a in (0,h-1) or b in (0,w-1)

     if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and grid[x][y]==bg and (x,y) not in seen: seen.add((x,y)); q.append((x,y))
   if not border:
    for a,b in comp: out[a][b]=bg+ (max(sum(grid,[]))-bg)
 return out
out=transform(grid)
print([(r,c) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if out[r][c]!=grid[r][c]])
